name: Melixie Sprite
text: You have the features of a bee, butterfly, moth, or other insect that loves sweets. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with arthropods (including insects, spiders, scorpions, crabs, and similar invertebrate animals). In most cases, wild arthropods will give you time to make your case. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to make-an-impression on arthropods.
